target_customer: Customer support teams using Intercom, Zendesk or Help Scout
problem: Support agents spend time writing replies. Parabolic drafted ready to send responses inside the helpdesk.
business_model: Usage based pricing on ticket volume with no upfront charge (per a directory summary)
product_category: AI reply drafting for customer support

founders.name: Shub Viragi
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no bio. A dead startups directory says he later joined Uber as a senior AI product manager; unverified.

competitors.name: Intercom
competitors.what: Helpdesk that added GPT-3.5 features including Composer, which turns shorthand into full suggested replies in the inbox
competitors.traction_then: Large installed base among support teams (company scale not quantified in the source)

technical_complexity.rationale: A wrapper around large language models integrated with helpdesk apps; integration work was modest for two founders.

defensibility.rationale: Helpdesk platforms could ship the same drafting feature natively, as Intercom announced in January 2023.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Intercom announced GPT based reply composition on 2023-01-31 and Fin in March 2023, absorbing the wedge into the host platform.

market_need_then: The release of ChatGPT in late 2022 raised demand for AI drafted support replies and support teams had large ticket volumes, though the host platforms moved quickly.

branding.domain_note: Used growparabolic.com, a prefix on the real word, suggesting the plain .com was unavailable (inferred, not sourced)
branding.community_and_virality: Listed on AI tool directories; no community or press about the brand

brand_strength.rationale: Only directory listings exist; other companies such as Parabolic Studio share the name.

outcome_analysis: Parabolic was a two person YC W23 company drafting support replies with large language models. It raised about 500K in a single pre-seed, and a dead startups directory says it wound down quietly in 2023 with no follow on round. Intercom shipped similar reply composition in January 2023, so the wedge was absorbed by the host platform. The directory's cause is speculation and not confirmed.
notes: Company site growparabolic.com did not resolve. The 500K pre-seed in April 2023 rests on VCBacked and a dead startups directory (aggregators, no press release). The wind down in 2023 and the likely cause come only from a dead startups compilation and are unverified. Failure factors are inferred from that and from Intercom's launch. Many tool directories still list Parabolic as live and are outdated.
